scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,clima,afluencia 'bun run dev:web' 'bun run dev:clima' 'bun run dev:afluencia'
scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --locked --all-packages ruff check . && uv run --locked --all-packages ruff format --check .
scripts.format: biome check --write . && uv run --locked --all-packages ruff check --fix . && uv run --locked --all-packages ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @pavas/web typecheck && uv run --locked --all-packages mypy
scripts.test: bun run --filter @pavas/web test && uv run --locked --all-packages pytest
scripts.test:coverage: bun run --filter @pavas/web test:coverage && uv run --locked --all-packages pytest --cov=pavas_clima --cov=pavas_afluencia --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.build: bun run --filter @pavas/web build && uv build --package pavas-clima && uv build --package pavas-afluencia
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
